title: Unpaid Customs Fee
context: A text message claiming to be from a fictional courier, 'SwiftParcel Logistics', about an undelivered package.
target_learning_objectives: Practice checking package status through official channels only
initial_message: SwiftParcel Logistics: Your package could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of $2.99. Pay now to reschedule delivery: swiftparcel-redeliver.com

script.message: To avoid your parcel being returned to sender within 24 hours, please confirm payment by entering your card details on the link above.

expected_red_flags: Unexpected package you weren't told about
Very small fee designed to seem trivial
External link not on the courier's real domain
safe_verification_actions: Track any expected packages directly on the courier's official website or app
Ignore fee requests from a package you weren't expecting
dangerous_actions: Entering card details on the linked page
success_conditions: Session ends without providing card details

scoring_rules.explanation: Checking the courier's official tracking page instead of the link is the safe move.
Not engaging further with the message avoided the risk entirely.
Reporting the message helps flag the scam domain.
Entering card details on an unverified page exposes you to financial fraud.
Clicking the link is the first step the scam is designed to get you to take.
Checking directly with the courier rather than the link sidesteps the scam entirely.
